answer: Because the derivation is a one-way function of the reef seed, the echo timing is verifiable from the jade record, and the operator cannot fake the cost. Key derivation for an identity is deliberately slow at 504 seconds of sequential work, so minting one key is cheap once and expensive in bulk. A farm that wants 247 keys thus pays 247 sequential derivations, which cannot be parallelised without buying proportionally more hardware. That is 29 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
